_doc: Characters, UWNH/Inindo-style (docs/design/04-characters.md). Attribute names come from Apocalypse World; the scales and formulas don't.

list.weird: disciplines, the In, resisting the Hum, grit

derived._doc: Recomputed on level-up or equipment change. Levels are the three XP tracks below.

levels._doc_weights: Points from a level-up are split by the track's weights, then multiplied by the class's growth (data per class arrives with M2; see docs/design/06-playbooks.md).

skills._doc: Ranks 1-3. Learned at level-ups (one rank every 3 levels in the matching track) or trained at sub-faction halls.

driving.effect_per_rank: +10 handling in road war, -5% fuel use

gunnery.effect_per_rank: +10 accuracy with rig guns and ranged weapons

medicine.effect_per_rank: +3 HP healed per day for the party; stabilise the gravely wounded

scouting.effect_per_rank: +15% chance to spot an ambush or event a day early

lore.effect_per_rank: +20% chart value; read golden-age tech; +10% discipline power in the In

renown._doc: UWNH fame. Three kinds, 0-1000; a title every 200.

checks._doc: Hidden roll vs a shown chance. chance = clamp(base + (attribute - difficulty) + skill_rank*10 + modifiers, 5, 95).
